newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's PT Inco 1996 net down.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's PT Inco 1996 net down.

text.p: PT International Nickel Indonesia (PT Inco) said on Thursday it posted a net profit of $61.2 million in 1996, compared with $96.0 million the previous year.

PT Inco said in a statement that the profit drop meant earnings per share fell from 39 cents in 1995 to 25 cents in 1996. Net earnings for the fourth quarter in 1996 were $7.2 million, or three cents per share, compared with $25.4 million, or 11 cents per share, in the corresponding period of 1995.

The company said the decrease in net earnings in the fourth quarter and the year 1996, relative to the corresponding 1995 periods, principally reflected lower nickel price realisations, lower deliveries, increased unit production costs and higher income taxes.

The statement said the company's realised price for nickel in matte averaged $2.72 per pound in 1996 and $2.53 per pound in the fourth quarter of 1996, compared with $2.95 per pound and $2.96 per pound, respectively, in the corresponding periods of 1995.
It said production of nickel in matte in the fourth quarter of 1996 was 12.7 million pounds, compared with the 27.8 million pounds record level achieved in the corresponding 1995 period.
The low production level in the fourth quarter of 1996 was primarily due to an eruption in Furnace No.3 in September 1996, it said.

The rebuild of Furnace No.3 was completed two weeks ahead of schedule and it returned to full production during the second half of December, it said, adding the property damage and the losses from the interuption were mostly covered by insurance.
(in million dollars except earnings per share)
Earnings per share 25 cents vs 39 cents
Note: The results were unaudited. Inco is 58.7 percent owned by Inco Ltd of Canada.
